name: watchNewStudies
label: Watch new studies
description: Triggers when a new study is created.

name: createStudy
label: Create a study
description: Creates a new study and optionally attaches existing audiences. Does not run research.

name: getStudy
label: Get a study
description: Returns information about a specific study by its ID.

name: listStudies
label: List studies
description: Returns a list of studies, most recently updated first.

name: getStudySummary
label: Get a study summary
description: Returns the saved aggregate summary of a specific study by its ID. The summary is empty until one exists in Minds.

name: previewResearchPlan
label: Preview a research plan
description: Drafts a reviewable research plan for a study. Research does not run until someone confirms the plan in Minds.

name: makeApiCall
label: Make an API call
description: Sends a custom API call to Minds. You can use this to call endpoints that aren’t covered by existing modules.
